h1: Dener CNC press brakes — hydraulic, hybrid, servo-electric and ball-screw
intro: A press brake bends sheet and plate between a punch and a V-die; the CNC positions the back gauge and controls the ram depth, crowning and angle, so the operator loads the sheet and presses the pedal. NovoTech sells Dener press brakes in Canada — the XL hydraulic press brake in 18 models from 66 to 661 US tons and 5 to 20 ft, the XH hybrid that puts a servo pump on the same frame for 42 – 58 % less energy, the DDM servo-electric press brake with no hydraulic oil from 44 to 220 US tons, and the DDS ball-screw press brake from 22 US tons for small parts. ESA S640 / S875 or Delem DA-66S / 69S controls, European-style tooling, back gauges to 6 axes, crowning, angle measurement, sheet followers and robot cells. This is the premium line; NovoTech's own value-line CNC press brakes and the ISITAN compact press brakes have pages of their own. Installed and supported from Mississauga, ON, with a CSA-approved panel and Dener Canada parts.

faq.q: Hydraulic, hybrid or servo-electric — which press brake should I buy?
faq.a: A hydraulic XL is the lowest price per ton and bends anything from 5 ft brackets to 20 ft, 1/2″ plate; it is the right machine when tonnage and length matter more than cycle time. The XH hybrid is the same machine with a servo pump: it costs a little more and pays it back in power (42 – 58 % less), speed and noise — the right choice for a shop that runs the brake all day. The DDM servo-electric brake has no oil at all, bends at twice the speed with 0.01 mm repeatability and draws power only while the ram moves — the choice for high-mix job shops and clean environments up to 220 US tons × 13 ft. Below 44 tons the DDS ball-screw brake is the compact, plug-in electric machine for boxes and brackets.

faq.q: How much tonnage do I need?
faq.a: Air bending mild steel with the standard V = 8 × thickness die takes roughly 8 US tons per foot for 16 ga, 15 tons per foot for 1/8″, 30 for 3/16″, 55 for 1/4″ and 130 tons per foot for 1/2″; stainless needs about 50 % more, aluminum about half. A 10 ft × 1/4″ job is therefore a 135 – 175 ton machine, 10 ft × 1/2″ a 320 – 400 ton machine. Tell us the thickest and longest bend you make and we size the brake and the tooling.

faq.q: Which control comes with the machine?
faq.a: The XL and DDS come with the 15″ ESA S640 2D graphic control: draw the profile, the control calculates the bend sequence, tonnage, back-gauge positions and crowning. The DDM comes with the 21″ ESA S875 W 3D control with 3D simulation and offline programming. Delem DA-66S (2D) and DA-69S (3D) are options on every machine, as is the ESA S875 W on the XL. All of them program in inches or millimetres and import DXF files.

faq.q: What is a hybrid press brake?
faq.a: On a conventional hydraulic brake the motor and pump run at full speed all day, whether the ram moves or not. The XH hybrid replaces the AC motor and fixed pump with a servo motor driving an inverter pump: the pump turns only while the ram moves, at the speed the ram needs. Dener measures 42 – 58 % energy saving and 17 – 75 % faster approach and return against the XL of the same tonnage, with less heat in the oil and a quieter shop. Everything else — frame, cylinders, valves, tooling, controls — is the XL.

faq.q: What back gauge and axes are available?
faq.a: Every machine has the Y1 and Y2 ram axes and an X back-gauge axis on a ball screw and linear guides; the DDM adds R (height) as standard. Options go up to the 6-axis ATF gauge with X1, X2, R1, R2, Z1 and Z2 — two independently positioned fingers for angled flanges — plus a CNC crowning axis and the Dual X-Prime fingers. The back gauge is set by the control for every bend of the program.

European-style (Promecam / Amada) segmented punches and dies with European-style holders are standard; Wila mechanical or hydraulic clamping, quick-release and pneumatic clamping are options, and American-style tooling can be fitted with an adapter. NovoTech stocks Eurostamp press brake tooling in Canada — punches, dies, radius tools, hemming and joggle tools — and sizes it to your machine.

faq.q: Do you deliver, install and service in Canada?
faq.a: Yes. Machines ship from Kayseri to Mississauga; we unload, level, commission and train your operators, and Dener Canada stocks parts here. Every machine comes with a CSA-approved panel, 600 V standard (208 / 240 / 480 V on request), a 1-year warranty and remote diagnostics through the control.

faq.q: What voltage do these machines run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor. Manual machines have no electrics.
